description: A 300K-token input arrives as an artefact handle: split it with delegate_chunks and reduce, never read it inline (stage 2a, G2, G12).
prompt: Last night's production log is stored as artefact art_7f3a (about 300K tokens; outline: 6 services, 02:00-06:00 UTC, one line per event). Find every burst of errors and its likely cause.

replies.report: Chunk 1 (02:00-03:20): one burst, payments, 02:14-02:19, 412 errors 'connection pool exhausted'; likely cause: pool size 10 under the 02:10 batch job.
Chunk 3 (04:40-06:00): one burst, search, 05:31-05:33, 88 timeouts after a deploy at 05:30; likely cause: cold index cache.
Merged: two bursts. payments 02:14-02:19 (connection pool exhausted by the 02:10 batch job); search 05:31-05:33 (timeouts from a cold cache after the 05:30 deploy).

arguments.brief:
## Goal
Find every burst of errors in your chunk of a production log and its likely cause.

## Context
The log covers 6 services from 02:00 to 06:00 UTC, one line per event. A burst is at least 20 errors from one service within 5 minutes.

## Constraints
Report only what the chunk shows; mark guesses as likely.

## Acceptance
- Every burst listed with service, start and end time, error count and a sample message.

## Output format
One line per burst: service, time range, count, sample message, likely cause. Say 'no bursts' if none.
arguments.reduce: Merge the chunk reports into one list of bursts, joining bursts split across chunk boundaries, ordered by time.

reference.content:
Two error bursts last night:
1. payments, 02:14-02:19 UTC, 412 'connection pool exhausted' errors; likely the 02:10 batch job exhausting a pool of 10.
2. search, 05:31-05:33 UTC, 88 timeouts right after the 05:30 deploy; likely a cold index cache.
Nothing else rose above background noise.
